newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's defense minister resigns -- official.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's defense minister resigns -- official.

text.p: Ecuador's defense minister resigned on Saturday amid reports that the military had withdrawn all support from the government of embattled President Abdala Bucaram.
"General Victor Bayas has resigned the post of defense minister," the ministry said in a terse statement.

The statement gave no reason for Bayas' sudden decision to join the three other cabinet officials, including Energy Minister Alfredo Adum, who have abandoned Bucaram's government in the last 48 hours.
But it said Bayas, who declared a nationwide state of emergency on Friday to quell anti-Bucaram protests, had issued a call for "peace and order" amid the country's political crisis.
The people of Ecuador should work for a better future for "the fatherland and society without excesses that could have lamentable consequences," the statement said.
Armed forces chief Gen. Paco Moncayo was named to replace Bayas as acting defense minister.
